finance.invoices.v1.BillableTimeEntry.description:
BillableTimeEntry is approved billable HR time that has not been linked to
a finance invoice yet.

date.description: date is the day on which the time was logged.

description.description: description is the time entry description.

duration_minutes.description: duration_minutes is the approved billable duration.

employee_id.description: employee_id identifies the employee who logged the time.

id.description: id is the unique identifier for the time entry.

is_billable.description: is_billable is always true for this response.

project_id.description: project_id identifies the optional Flow project.

source.description: source identifies the system that recorded the time.

status.description: status is always approved for this response.

task_id.description: task_id identifies the optional Flow task.

customer_id.description:
customer_id is the CRM customer to issue to. When supplied the server
snapshots that customer's name, email, address and tax id onto the
invoice and the client_* fields above may be omitted. When absent the
server requires client_name and client_email, which is the existing
behaviour. The server must verify the referenced customer belongs to
the caller's business before accepting the link.
